title: Xobin Products: Hire & Grow Talent on One Platform
text:
Search products
Sourcing & Candidate Ops
Getting resumes, pipelines and follow-ups to run themselves.
Book a NURA Demo
Bring your recruiting brief and see the parsing, outreach, interview, evaluation and handoff journey described in NURA’s offer.
Explore
Xobin Product Tour
Follow an illustrative candidate journey from application intake to the evidence your recruiting team reviews.
NURA
Your recruiting team sets the brief. NURA connects the candidate stages described in Xobin’s original recruiting-agent offer.
Campus Recruitment Software
Give freshers a chance to show what they can do, from college drives to the first interview.
Resume Parsing
Turn scattered resumes into a clean, searchable talent pool in seconds.
Candidate Pool Management
Keep every qualified candidate visible and ready for the next open role.
Candidate Messages & Outreach
Reach candidates where they are email, text and WhatsApp in one thread.
Recruitment Automations
Put repetitive hiring tasks on autopilot so your team focuses on people.
MCP Capabilities
Let your AI agents read and act on your hiring stack through one protocol.
ATS Integrations
Connect Xobin to your ATS and stop copying candidate data by hand.
Tracks (ATS)
Applicant tracking that keeps every requisition, stage and interviewer in one place. Move candidates forward without chasing status over email.
Assessment API & Integrations
Push assessments and pull results straight from the systems you already run. A documented API and ready connectors do the plumbing.
Skills & Job Simulations
Tests built around the work, not around a syllabus.
Simulation Based Assessments
Put candidates in realistic scenarios and watch them solve real problems.
Certifications Assessments
Test the skill behind the certificate, not just the course they completed.
Excel Based Assessments
A resume says “Excel.” A live model proves whether they can build with it.
Job Simulation Assessments
Let candidates step into the role and prove they can do the actual work.
Role Specific Simulation Assessments
Test against the exact situations this role throws at them every day.
AI Fluency Assessment
See who can actually get work done with AI, not just prompt a chatbot.
Adaptive Assessments
Adjust every question in real time so candidates hit their true ceiling.
Business Skill Assessments
Measure the business skills a role actually needs, from finance to marketing operations. Benchmarked scores, not gut feel.
Coding Skill Assessments
Real coding problems run in a live editor across 50+ programming languages and frameworks. Auto-graded on output, quality and time taken.
Skill Test Portfolio
A library of 3,400+ prebuilt skills tests, validated and ready to send today. Pick one instead of writing questions from scratch.
Job Test Portfolio
2,500+ prebuilt job role-based tests mapped to real job titles, from analyst to plant supervisor. Choose the role and the test is already built.
Communication & Language
How someone speaks, writes, listens and holds a conversation.
Video Assessments
Watch candidates explain and present so you see what a resume cannot show.
Communication Assessments
Score how well candidates listen, explain and make themselves understood.
CEFR Test
Turn “fluent in English” into a CEFR level you can actually compare.
Roleplays
See how candidates persuade, listen and think when the conversation gets real.
English Communication Checker
Score spoken and written English on fluency, grammar, clarity and pronunciation. Ideal for support, sales and any customer-facing hire.
Personality & Behaviour
Traits, motivations and how a person tends to work.
DISC Behavioural Profile
See how someone scores across the four DISC work styles.
Personality Dimensions (Big Five) Assessment
Five traits that show how someone works with others and handles pressure.
HEXACO Personality Traits
Six traits, including Honesty-Humility, for a fuller picture of personality.
Cognitive Preference Type
Understand how someone takes in information and decides under pressure.
Dark Triad
Spot the traits no one lists on a resume before they cost your team.
Emotional Intelligence
Measure self-awareness, empathy and regulation when it matters most.
Psychometric Testing Software
Validated personality, motivation and behaviour tests in one place, with reports a hiring manager can actually read. Built on published research.
AI Interviews
Structured interviews that scale without losing the thread.
Book a AI Interviews Demo
Review role-contextual interview questions, scoring, follow-ups and the evidence your recruiters receive.
Guided AI Interviews
Give AI the goals and let it follow the thread, probe deeper and stay fair.
Controlled AI Interviews
Run every interview with the same questions, scoring and zero drift.
Automated Video Interviews
One-way video interviews candidates record on their own time, reviewed by your panel on yours. Screening rounds stop needing a calendar.
AI Evaluate
Long-form and subjective answers graded against your rubric in seconds. Every score comes with the reasoning behind it.
Test Integrity
Keeping remote assessments honest and defensible.
Advanced AI Proctoring
Configure remote-assessment safeguards and give reviewers evidence to examine, without treating every flag as an automatic rejection.
Enterprise White Labeling
Bring your brand to an assessment workflow, with the scope and candidate experience agreed before rollout.
Lockdown Browser
Lock the browser and proctor the session, so a remote test still counts.
Forms & Intake
What you ask candidates before anything else happens.
AI Driven Forms
Forms that follow the conversation and ask the next right question.
XoForms
Application forms that collect exactly what you need, cleanly and on brand. Candidates finish them; your team stops re-typing answers.
Performance & Feedback
Reviews, feedback and whether the strategy is happening.
Book a x360 Demo
Review a workforce feedback cycle, employee survey or development conversation with the Xobin team.
x360
Bring performance feedback, employee listening and development conversations into a more considered workforce programme.
Performance Management
Track goals, feedback and progress continuously instead of once a year.
360° Feedback
Collect manager, peer and report feedback for a rounded view of impact.
Manager Effectiveness & Leadership Feedback
Measure manager effectiveness through trust, direction and delegation feedback.
Execution, Accountability & Strategy Pulse
See where alignment, ownership and follow-through break down every quarter.
Skills & Development
Where the gaps are and what closes them.
Employee's Skill Assessments
Measure and benchmark employee competencies on one common scale.
Learning & Development
Turn skill gaps into personal learning paths people actually finish.
Skill Gap Analysis
See which skills you have, which you need and who can close the gap.
Engagement & Listening
What your team would tell you if you asked properly.
Request Your AI Readiness Pulse Check
Tell the Xobin team about your workforce and the AI-readiness questions you want to explore.
AI Readiness Pulse Check
Understand the AI questions your workforce needs to address before choosing the next training or governance programme.
Employee Surveys
Run every employee survey and engagement pulse from one place.
Employee Wellbeing & Team Climate Pulse
Catch wellbeing, safety and collaboration issues before they grow costly.
Exit Interviews
Learn why people actually leave so you can protect those still staying.
Org Design & Succession
Who does what, who connects what, and who's next.
Succession Planning
Know who is ready for the seat before it opens, not after it is empty.
Adaptive Organization Chart
A living org chart that also maps how work really flows.
